newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Moody's rates SPARS No 2 CP programme Prime 1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates SPARS No 2 CP programme Prime 1.

text.p: Moody's Investor Services said on Friday it had assigned a Prime 1 rating to the Australian dollar asset-backed commercial paper issued by Structured Prime Asset Receivables (SPARS) Number 2 under the A$236 million programme established by Bankers Trust Australia.

Moody's said the rating was based on the credit quality of the underlying assets backing the commercial paper (CP) in the form of Euro-Yen Floating Rate Notes to be issued by ATP Ltd, a special purpose company incorporated in the Cayman Islands.

It was also based on the obligations of the currency swap provider, Bankers Trust Australia, to meet Australian dollar payments to CP holders by taking the Australian currency risks through the currency swap agreement.
